def tree_predict(tree, X):
    out = []
    for x in X:
        node = tree
        while "leaf" not in node:
            go_left = x[node["feature"]] <= node["threshold"]
            node = node["left"] if go_left else node["right"]
        out.append(node["leaf"])
    return out

tree = {"feature": 0, "threshold": 5.0,
